name: excellent
description: Restaurant groups' private dining, events and operations in ChatGPT: the morning brief, inquiries and booking, rooms, invoices and money owed, the staff week, training and marketing, with drafts a person decides in Excellent and changes that can be undone.

interface.longDescription:
Excellent is the operating platform for restaurant groups' private dining and events. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about your group's live Excellent data in plain language: upcoming events and bookings across every location (one at a time in full, with its menu, contacts, payments, history, seating and custom fields), inbound leads, invoices and deposits still owed, proposals and contracts, rooms and when they are available, the staff schedule and training roster, an agenda of the coming days, one search across all of it, and the group events report with booking pace against your revenue goal.

With draft access, ChatGPT can also draft into your team's review queues: a reply to an inquiry, a proposal, banquet event order or contract priced from your own menus, an invoice or a payment installment on one, the day's pre-shift note, a staff shift, a thank-you card, a social post, a bilingual guest email, a training course built from your own lessons, new words for one of your automatic event emails, and, with Excellent Partner, a pro forma, pitch deck or investor update whose figures Excellent traces from your own records. It can revise a social post, guest email or invoice that is still a draft, and stage a table of contacts, menu items, inquiries, past events, staff or social posts as an import. Each comes with a review link that works only for you, signed in to Excellent; nothing is sent, published, added or finalized until you decide it there.

With change access, it can also make everyday changes as you, each one undoable for 30 days: create and book events, hold, block or book rooms, close a venue for a holiday or a buyout, turn a hold into an event, move an event or an inquiry along the pipeline, change a guest count, host, extra rooms, table seating or custom field, assign or snooze an inquiry, add contacts, notes and investor contacts, keep look-alike contacts apart, create a marketing list, add staff and correct their details, define competencies and assign training. It never sends, publishes, takes payments or deletes a record: clearing a value is an undoable change like any other, and undo takes back only what its own change did.

Each connection sees exactly one restaurant group, the one you approve, and acts as you, with only what your role in Excellent allows. Amounts are returned in cents. You choose read-only, drafts, or drafts and changes on Excellent's approval screen, and you can disconnect any time from Settings → AI assistant access in Excellent.

Requires an Excellent account. Docs: beexcellent.ai/mcp.
defaultPrompt: What does the next two weeks of private events look like across all our locations?
Which new leads haven't been contacted yet, and what dates and party sizes are they asking about?
How are we pacing against this year's events revenue goal, and which location is behind?

prompts: What does the next two weeks of private events look like across all our locations?
Which new leads haven't been contacted yet, and what dates and party sizes are they asking about?
How are we pacing against this year's events revenue goal, and which location is behind?

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the reviewer test account. It holds a sample restaurant group, My Restaurant Group, with four venues (Lumière Scottsdale, Lumière Tempe, Lumière Phoenix, Hearth Phoenix), made-up events, inquiries and invoices; contact emails use example.com addresses. Open one completed event in full and read what has been paid.
positive.prompt: Show me the Winter Gala — Adler event in full, including what has been paid.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Winter Gala — Adler: a completed event at Lumière Scottsdale for 80 guests, booked by referral. Its invoice is paid in full: $16,000.00 (80 guests at $200 per guest, catering). Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the reviewer test account. It holds a sample restaurant group, My Restaurant Group, with four venues (Lumière Scottsdale, Lumière Tempe, Lumière Phoenix, Hearth Phoenix), made-up events, inquiries and invoices; contact emails use example.com addresses. List the inquiries nobody has answered yet.
positive.prompt: List every inquiry with status new, with the event type, party size and requested date for each.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 4 new inquiries, all marked as sample data: Daniela Ferro, Rehearsal dinner, 30 guests; Priya Nair, Anniversary dinner, 24 guests (Lumière Scottsdale form); Marisol Ibáñez, Corporate dinner, 110 guests (Lumière Tempe form); Grace Okonkwo, Anniversary, 75 guests (Hearth Phoenix form). Each carries the requested date stored on it. Jonah Blake (contacted), Marcus Webb (qualified), Tomas Vega (contacted) and Renata Cruz (lost) are not listed because their status is not new.

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the reviewer test account. It holds a sample restaurant group, My Restaurant Group, with four venues (Lumière Scottsdale, Lumière Tempe, Lumière Phoenix, Hearth Phoenix), made-up events, inquiries and invoices; contact emails use example.com addresses. Read the group events report for the year and compare locations.
positive.prompt: Using the events report for the year, what is our annual revenue goal, how are we pacing against it, and what has each location booked and collected?
positive.expected_behavior: Relays the report's pace headline and the group's annual goal for the year it is run, when one is set (the sample group's goal is $600,000). It lists the four venues, Lumière Scottsdale, Lumière Tempe, Lumière Phoenix and Hearth Phoenix, with events, guests, booked and collected amounts. It says the figures come from sample data. The report holds one group-level goal, so it does not give a goal per venue; any 'behind' comparison is based on booked and collected amounts. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the reviewer test account. It holds a sample restaurant group, My Restaurant Group, with four venues (Lumière Scottsdale, Lumière Tempe, Lumière Phoenix, Hearth Phoenix), made-up events, inquiries and invoices; contact emails use example.com addresses. Check whether one room is free on a fixed future date, so the answer does not depend on when the test is run.
positive.prompt: Is the Garden Terrace at Lumière Scottsdale free on Tuesday, January 15, 2030, for 60 guests?
positive.expected_behavior: Garden Terrace at Lumière Scottsdale has capacity 120, so 60 guests fit. Venue hours that Tuesday are 17:00 to 23:00 (Phoenix time; Monday is closed). There are no bookings, holds or blocks that day, so the room is free for the whole open window, 17:00 to 23:00. Nothing is booked.

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the reviewer test account. It holds a sample restaurant group, My Restaurant Group, with four venues (Lumière Scottsdale, Lumière Tempe, Lumière Phoenix, Hearth Phoenix), made-up events, inquiries and invoices; contact emails use example.com addresses. Draft a thank-you card for a completed event. The draft goes to a review queue and is never sent.
positive.prompt: Draft a thank-you card for the Wine Pairing Dinner — Alvarez.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Wine Pairing Dinner — Alvarez, a completed dinner for 40 guests in the Main Dining Room at Lumière Scottsdale, and drafts a thank-you card using the 2 guest photos on its photo wall. It may show the plan and ask for confirmation first; reply 'Yes, go ahead.' The result says the draft is waiting for review and gives a review link that opens only when signed in to Excellent. ChatGPT states the card was not published or sent.

negative.description: General hospitality advice that does not need the group's records. Answers from general knowledge and calls no Excellent tool.
negative.prompt: What should a restaurant ask a guest to confirm before taking a deposit for a private dinner?

negative.description: Writing text in the chat for the user to use elsewhere. Writes the note in the chat and calls no Excellent tool, because no event or draft in Excellent was asked for.
negative.prompt: Write a short, warm thank-you note I can paste into an email to a couple who hosted their rehearsal dinner with us.

negative.description: General marketing research that is not about the user's own events. Gives general ideas (it may search the web) and calls no Excellent tool.
negative.prompt: What are some good ways to promote private dining rooms on Instagram?

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold or paid for inside ChatGPT. Excellent can draft invoices that a person reviews and sends from Excellent; guests pay inside Excellent, never in ChatGPT, and the connector never charges anyone.

publication.release_notes: First release of Excellent for ChatGPT.
